description:
Nestled in a serene rural setting, this deceptively spacious six-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and privacy. Recently renovated to the highest standards, this stunning residence features brand-new bathrooms, plush carpets, fresh paintwork, elegant wainscot panelling, modern appliances throughout and a new Bio Cycle. 

Step through the welcoming open-plan tiled porch into a spacious living room that sets the tone for the rest of the home. The heart of this residence is the expansive open-plan kitchen and dining area, complete with a striking central island and sleek granite countertops—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining guests. Relax in the cozy sitting room, where a charming solid fuel stove provides warmth and ambiance, complemented by a stylish bar area for your enjoyment. 

The ground floor also boasts three bedrooms, one of which has ensuite facilities, alongside a family bathroom, providing ample space for family and guests.
Upstairs, discover a luxurious master suite complete with private ensuite, plus two additional bedrooms and a shower room, ensuring everyone has their own sanctuary.

This magnificent home perfectly combines rural tranquillity with modern elegance—a true sanctuary to call your own.
Without doubt this property brings numerous additional features coupled with a central location of Clonalvy near Drogheda, Ashbourne, Balbriggan and Stamullen. 

To appreciate this magnificent residence together with its wonderful grounds and enormous potential, viewing is essential!!
